parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

Don’t ____ to message me to see if I’m available for a chat. Just call me any time.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: While shopping on holiday, we completely failed to take allowance for our limited luggage space.
Liz couldn’t wait for the results of the vote. The prospects of being appointed to such a senior government position made her feel enormously excited.
Our chemistry teacher disapproved on the experiment we did.
I told you about my plan with confidence, so why does Robert know all about it?!
Matt attempted escaping through the window, but they pulled him back inside.
This food is great! How long is it since we’ve eaten in a restaurant together? Ages, isn’t it?!
Desmond is a strange boss. Sometimes, it’s impossible to work onto what he expects you to do.
As your doctor, Mrs White, I recommend you cut down for coffee. Eight cups a day is too many.
The street noise outside our window isn’t something I’m willing to put up on. I’m going to ask for a new room.
Greg was the best player in our team at far. He could have become a professional.

parts.text: By an earnest person, we mean someone who’s serious and sincere. We call the sides of a river the banks. Railway tracks are the lines on which trains run. The three forms of “spin” are “spin, spun, spun”. The three forms of “weave” are “weave, wove, woven”. We can make cloth and baskets by weaving. The verb “account for” means “give a reason or explanation for”. The three forms of “bleed” are “bleed, bled, bled”. A mechanic repairs cars and other machines. Young children call adults grown-ups. We are now approaching London Kings Cross. Did you see that flash of lightning? The blade on this knife needs to be kept sharp.
